entries.name: Balance Assist
entries.rule_summary: Ordinary narrow footing, unstable surfaces, and controlled landings do not alone require a roll; extreme or contested movement still does.

entries.name: Grip Assist
entries.rule_summary: Maintain an ordinary human-manageable climb, hold, or tool grip with one hand when two would normally be required.

entries.name: Cover Protocol
entries.rule_summary: After taking Cover, add d4 as a VAM die to the first appropriate defense before your next turn.

entries.name: Combat Rescue
entries.rule_summary: Carry, drag, or support an adjacent ally during your normal Move without automatically reducing normal movement distance when physically plausible.

entries.name: Motion Prediction
entries.rule_summary: Add d4 as a VAM die on Dodge against a visible moving attacker whose motion you can track.

entries.name: Protective Intercept
entries.rule_summary: Reaction: move a short distance to become an eligible target of an attack directed at an adjacent or immediately reachable ally.

entries.name: Adrenal Control
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene, spend 1 AP to clear one temporary physiological/shock-based Stunned, Disoriented, or equivalent condition.

entries.name: Breach Window
entries.rule_summary: After a team breach or forced entry succeeds, Move through the opening for 0 AP; linked allies may spend their Reaction to follow a short distance.

entries.name: Tactical Reposition
entries.rule_summary: After a visible enemy misses you with an attack, spend your Reaction to Move a short distance.

entries.name: Kinetic Mastery Suite
entries.rule_summary: Qualifying dangerous movement rolls with the appropriate Mastered Skill include its Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Evasion Forecast
entries.rule_summary: Against a threat you can perceive before resolution, qualifying defenses include the Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Rescue Cascade
entries.rule_summary: Once per round after successfully protecting, stabilizing, moving, or extracting an ally, either you or that ally may immediately Move a short distance for 0 AP.

entries.name: Momentum Reserve
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene after spending all 3 AP on movement, rescue, or protective actions, take one additional non-Attack Interact, Take Cover, or Guard action for 0 AP.

entries.name: Survival Envelope
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene, spend your Reaction to attempt an appropriate Mastery-enabled interception, movement, or defense roll for a linked ally facing a catastrophic physical consequence.
